correctness.rationale: For exact Q=P-I the geometric resolvent is row-stochastic and positive. Small cycles have explicitly evaluated diagonal and squared entries, including a complete positivity criterion for n=3. The finite-group inverse K has coefficient (n-3)/(2n) in the forward transition, giving fixed-s negativity for n>=4. The eigenvalue logarithm expansion yields uniform negative sign below m/sqrt(h) small and uniform proximity to the positive stationary projector when m/sqrt(h) is sufficiently large. Four-point Fourier inversion gives the unique scalar critical equation and all other entries positive. The 112 supplemental rational/numerical assertions passed; all infinite statements are derived analytically.

value.rationale: Entrywise Markov positivity is a structural requirement distinct from row-sum conservation or spectral stability. The theorem finds the sharp smallest directed-cycle dimension where a fixed number of squarings cannot guarantee it, quantifies the necessary growth rate, and identifies a complete exact asymptotic positivity frontier in four states; these provide substantive natural stress tests for exponential approximants.
